{{Quote|We're having trouble with the Fa'athra clan, and it's getting to all of us. Fa'athra's out of line, but the Hutt Cartel hasn't bothered to interfere.|[[Karrels Javis]]|<ref name="TOR:Soiree">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Soiree|Hutta}}</ref>}}
The '''Fa'athra clan''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan, or [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. One of its members was the Hutt [[Voontara Fa'athra|Voontara]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The Fa'athra clan had members that had quarrels with those of the [[Nem'ro clan]].

==Behind the scenes==
While the Fa'athra kajidic itself has not been mentioned, its existence is implied by the name of Voontara Fa'athra. According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', the ''[[cuirvas]]'' of a Hutt identified their clan.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> Its existence as a clan and criminal organization is also supported by the fact that the phrase "Fa'athra clan" is commonly used in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
